channelTitle: Upset stomach? Grandma's apple cider vinegar trick
hook: Stomach feeling off after a big meal? Grandma always kept a bottle of apple cider vinegar in the pantry for this.
remedy: A spoonful of apple cider vinegar stirred into warm water is a classic old-fashioned remedy people have reached for to settle an upset stomach after a heavy meal.
steps: Stir one tablespoon of apple cider vinegar into a glass of warm water
Add a little honey if you'd like it milder
Sip slowly, ideally after a meal rather than on an empty stomach
caution: Always dilute it — undiluted vinegar can irritate your throat and wear down tooth enamel over time. Skip it if you have acid reflux or ulcers.
cta: Follow along for more old-school home remedies
